title: The 2020 National Day Holiday
synopsis: 2020 has been a very special year, and the National Day holiday was a challenge for China this year.

fullText.simplified:
2020年的国庆假期：应对全球流行病

    2020年是特殊的一年，新冠疫情是全世界人们都关心和讨论的话题。
    在中国，2020年初的疫情影响正在慢慢减弱。经历了武汉疫情、北京疫情等几次大疫情后，中国人的防疫意识越来越高了。人们明白和理解政府采取防疫措施的目的，而且表现出了高度的配合。这也是中国能在短时间内控制住疫情的重要原因。
    2020年10月1号是中国的国庆节，也正好是农历的中秋节。人们有8天的假期。这对疫情防控来说是个挑战。
    在中国，无论是乘坐交通工具还是进出公共场所，人们一定要扫健康码。每人一个健康码，健康码是绿色的，代表通过；健康码是红色的，代表健康码持有人来自疫情高风险区或者曾经去过高风险区。红色的健康码是不允许进入公共场所的，需要隔离。这样就可以提前避免疫情传播的风险。
    去电影院看电影也是如此，除了扫描健康码以外，还要登记个人观影信息，禁止携带零食、摘口罩，每次观影人数有限制等，这些措施也会最大程度地保护人们。
    景区参观实行的是提前预约的方式，控制游览人数。
    总而言之，所有行业和部门都为假期的顺利进行做了最大的努力。
    各大媒体纷纷用“二次春运”来形容本次国庆假期。据统计，这个假期，有6亿多人短期出行，人口流动性特别大。但是在多方面的配合下，人们的假期生活有条不紊地进行着并且完美地结束了。
fullText.traditional:
2020年的國慶假期：應對全球流行病

    2020年是特殊的一年，新冠疫情是全世界人們都關心和討論的話題。
    在中國，2020年初的疫情影響正在慢慢減弱。經歷了武漢疫情、北京疫情等幾次大疫情後，中國人的防疫意識越來越高了。人們明白和理解政府採取防疫措施的目的，而且表現出了高度的配合。這也是中國能在短時間內控制住疫情的重要原因。
    2020年10月1號是中國的國慶節，也正好是農曆的中秋節。人們有8天的假期。這對疫情防控來說是個挑戰。
    在中國，無論是乘坐交通工具還是進出公共場所，人們一定要掃健康碼。每人一個健康碼，健康碼是綠色的，代表通過；健康碼是紅色的，代表健康碼持有人來自疫情高風險區或者曾經去過高風險區。紅色的健康碼是不允許進入公共場所的，需要隔離。這樣就可以提前避免疫情傳播的風險。
    去電影院看電影也是如此，除了掃描健康碼以外，還要登記個人觀影信息，禁止攜帶零食、摘口罩，每次觀影人數有限制等，這些措施也會最大程度地保護人們。
    景區參觀實行的是提前預約的方式，控制遊覽人數。
    總而言之，所有行業和部門都為假期的順利進行做了最大的努力。
    各大媒體紛紛用“二次春運”來形容本次國慶假期。據統計，這個假期，有6億多人短期出行，人口流動性特別大。但是在多方面的配合下，人們的假期生活有條不紊地進行著並且完美地結束了。

sentences.english: October 1, 2020 was China’s National Day, and also coincided with the Mid-Autumn Festival in the lunar calendar.
People had eight days off. This posed a challenge for epidemic prevention.

sentences.pinyin: měi rén yí ge jiàn kāng mǎ jiàn kāng mǎ shì lǜ sè de dài biǎo tōng guò
sentences.english: .. they had to scan a health code

sentences.simplified: 健康码是红色的，代表健康码持有人来自疫情高风险区或者曾经去过高风险区。
sentences.traditional: 健康碼是紅色的，代表健康碼持有人來自疫情高風險區或者曾經去過高風險區。
sentences.pinyin: jiàn kāng mǎ shì hóng sè de dài biǎo jiàn kāng mǎ chí yǒu rén lái zì yì qíng gāo fēng xiǎn qū huò zhě céng jīng qù guò gāo fēng xiǎn qū
sentences.english: Everyone has their own health code. If the code is green, it means they pass.

sentences.simplified: 红色的健康码是不允许进入公共场所的，需要隔离。
sentences.traditional: 紅色的健康碼是不允許進入公共場所的，需要隔離。

sentences.english: If the code is red, it means that the person comes from a high-risk area, or has passed through one.

sentences.simplified: 这样就可以提前避免疫情传播的风险。
sentences.traditional: 這樣就可以提前避免疫情傳播的風險。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiù kě yǐ tí qián bì miǎn yì qíng chuán bō de fēng xiǎn
sentences.english: A red health code does not allow entry into public places and shows that a person needs to isolate.
This way, the risk of the epidemic spreading can be avoided in advance.

sentences.simplified: 去电影院看电影也是如此，
sentences.traditional: 去電影院看電影也是如此，
sentences.pinyin: qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng yě shì rú cǐ

sentences.simplified: 除了扫描健康码以外，还要登记个人观影信息，
sentences.traditional: 除了掃描健康碼以外，還要登記個人觀影信息，

sentences.english: It was the same for those who want to go to the cinema.

sentences.simplified: 禁止携带零食、摘口罩，
sentences.traditional: 禁止攜帶零食、摘口罩，
sentences.pinyin: jìn zhǐ xié dài líng shí zhāi kǒu zhào
sentences.english: As well as scanning the health code, they also had to register and provide their personal movie viewing information, ..

sentences.simplified: 每次观影人数有限制等，
sentences.traditional: 每次觀影人數有限制等，
sentences.pinyin: měi cì guān yǐng rén shù yǒu xiàn zhì děng
sentences.english: .. it was forbidden to bring snacks or take off masks,

sentences.simplified: 这些措施也会最大程度地保护人们。
sentences.traditional: 這些措施也會最大程度地保護人們。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē cuò shī yě huì zuì dà chéng dù de bǎo hù rén men
sentences.english: .. and the number of people watching a movie each time was limited etc.
These measures also gave people the maximum protection.

sentences.simplified: 景区参观实行的是提前预约的方式，控制游览人数。
sentences.traditional: 景區參觀實行的是提前預約的方式，控制遊覽人數。
sentences.pinyin: jǐng qū cān guān shí xíng de shì tí qián yù yuē de fāng shì kòng zhì yóu lǎn rén shù

sentences.english: Visits to sightseeing spots also employed an advance booking system to control the number of visitors.

sentences.simplified: 总而言之，所有行业和部门都为假期的顺利进行做了最大的努力。
sentences.traditional: 總而言之，所有行業和部門都為假期的順利進行做了最大的努力。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng ér yán zhī suǒ yǒu háng yè hé bù mén dōu wèi jià qī de shùn lì jìn xíng zuò le zuì dà de nǔ lì

sentences.english: In short, all industries and departments did their best so that this holiday could go smoothly.

sentences.simplified: 各大媒体纷纷用“二次春运”来形容本次国庆假期。
sentences.traditional: 各大媒體紛紛用“二次春運”來形容本次國慶假期。
sentences.pinyin: gè dà méi tǐ fēn fēn yòng èr cì chūn yùn lái xíng róng běn cì guó qìng jià qī

sentences.simplified: 据统计，这个假期，有6亿多人短期出行，
sentences.traditional: 據統計，這個假期，有6億多人短期出行，
sentences.pinyin: jù tǒng jì zhè ge jià qī yǒu 1 yì duō rén duǎn qī chū xíng
sentences.english: Media outlets have successively described this year’s National Day holiday as “The second Spring Festival travel rush”.

sentences.simplified: 人口流动性特别大。
sentences.traditional: 人口流動性特別大。
sentences.pinyin: rén kǒu liú dòng xìng tè bié dà
sentences.english: According to statistics, more than 600 million people did take a short trip during this holiday, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是在多方面的配合下，人们的假期生活有条不紊地进行着并且完美地结束了。
sentences.traditional: 但是在多方面的配合下，人們的假期生活有條不紊地進行著並且完美地結束了。

sentences.english: .. and population mobility was particularly high.
But through coordination across many areas, people’s holidays were systematically arranged and concluded without issues.

In China, the impact of the epidemic at the beginning of 2020 is currently slowly weakening.
After experiencing several major outbreaks in Wuhan and Beijing etc., ..
.. Chinese people’s awareness of epidemic prevention is increasing.
People understand and appreciate the purpose of the government’s epidemic prevention measures, ..
.. and show a high degree of cooperation.
This is also an important reason why China was able to control the epidemic within a very short time.
October 1, 2020 was China’s National Day, and also coincided with the Mid-Autumn Festival in the lunar calendar.
People had eight days off. This posed a challenge for epidemic prevention.
In China, no matter whether people were taking public transport or entering and exiting public places, ..
.. they had to scan a health code
Everyone has their own health code. If the code is green, it means they pass.
If the code is red, it means that the person comes from a high-risk area, or has passed through one.
A red health code does not allow entry into public places and shows that a person needs to isolate.
This way, the risk of the epidemic spreading can be avoided in advance.
It was the same for those who want to go to the cinema.
As well as scanning the health code, they also had to register and provide their personal movie viewing information, ..
.. it was forbidden to bring snacks or take off masks,
.. and the number of people watching a movie each time was limited etc.
These measures also gave people the maximum protection.
Visits to sightseeing spots also employed an advance booking system to control the number of visitors.
In short, all industries and departments did their best so that this holiday could go smoothly.
Media outlets have successively described this year’s National Day holiday as “The second Spring Festival travel rush”.
According to statistics, more than 600 million people did take a short trip during this holiday, ..
.. and population mobility was particularly high.
But through coordination across many areas, people’s holidays were systematically arranged and concluded without issues.
